description: §5.2.3 — a BARE `;`-sequence handler on a button inside a `<match>` arm body fires E-MULTI-STATEMENT-HANDLER. Pre-S437 impl#1 re-parsed arm bodies with a nested buildAST whose errors were dropped, so the code never fired inside a match arm.
rationale: §5.2.3: "A BARE event-handler value that contains a `;` outside of expression-internal contexts … is compile error `E-MULTI-STATEMENT-HANDLER`." The rule has no positional exemption.
